of an annuity, no deduction shall be allowed in
respect   of such   annuity,  unless  such  annuity
is paid–

(A)
under an order of court by way of payment
of alimony or maintenance;

(B)
to his spouse under a duly executed deed

(C)

or money’s worth.

(iv)
where any sum is paid by such person by way
of  interest,  no  deduction  shall  be  allowed  in
respect of such interest, unless such interest is
paid under any legal or contractual obligation–

(A)
to any bank licensed under the Banking
Act,  No.  30  of  1988  or  any  finance
company  registered  under  the  Finance
Company Act, No. 78 of 1988; or

(B)
to  any  other  person  recognized  by  the
Commissioner-General for the purposes
of this paragraph :
Provided  however,  where  the  Commissioner-
General is satisfied that such recipient of interest has
declared such interest as income under this Act, such
person may be deemed to be a recognized person.
For  the  purposes  of  this  paragraph  the  term
“interest”  means  any  interest  paid  on  a  loan  the
proceeds of which are utilized—

(i)
for  the  construction  or  purchase  of  any
building or for the purchase of any site for the
